title: Replacement Amount for a Returned Payment on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The replacement amount for a payment the bank returned on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is the balance due on the agreement, in US dollars rounded to the cent, half up. Whatever the payment carries above the balance due stays on the agreement as a credit balance.

## Definition of the balance due
The balance due is the amount the tenant owes on the rental agreement as the agreement record shows it: rent and fees increase it, payments, credits and applied sale proceeds decrease it, and a payment the bank returned is added back to it by its reversal. A negative balance due is a credit balance owed back to the tenant.

## Worked figure (hypothetical agreement)

An agreement record showing a balance due of $212.40 gives a replacement amount of $212.40. A payment of $250.00 taken against that agreement brings the balance due to a credit balance of $37.60, which stays on the agreement.
